drills.notes: Coalescing never offered an exact-truth action while behind; it re-enabled them only after reaching the live epoch.

steps.narration: A burst of invalidations arrives faster than the strip can apply each delta.
Pending exact-truth actions switch to revalidate-before-act and a freshness cue appears.
The buffered deltas coalesce into one consistent frame applied in epoch order.
The coalesced frame reaches the live epoch and exact-truth actions re-enable.

drills.title: Rapid invalidation burst coalesces without claiming settled truth

drills.notes: Every trailing record carried an epoch stamp and freshness flag, so no consumer could read a lagging line as current truth.

steps.narration: Headless output detects it is emitting records behind the live epoch.
Each emitted record is stamped with its epoch and a not-current freshness flag.
Trailing deltas coalesce and the lane drains toward the live epoch.
Output reaches the live epoch and clears the not-current freshness flag.

drills.title: Consumer lag recovers via coalesced catch-up with visible freshness

drills.notes: The resubscribe was never silent; the banner made the changed action posture visible until the fresh epoch applied.

steps.narration: The review workspace detects its live subscription dropped.
Approve and merge disable behind a visible resubscribe-required banner.
The workspace resubscribes to the merge-queue and pipeline streams from a fresh snapshot epoch.
The fresh snapshot applies, the banner clears, and approve or merge re-enable.

drills.title: Reconnect requires a visible resubscribe before exact-truth actions resume

drills.notes: Honest recovery here means staying blocked and stale while the provider is gone; the drill proves the workspace does not pretend nothing changed.

steps.narration: The remote preview provider overlay stops responding and its rows are flagged.
Exact-truth actions that depended on the missing overlay are blocked and the rows are marked stale.
The workspace holds the stale marker and keeps trying to resubscribe to the provider.
With the provider still gone the rows stay blocked and stale rather than reverting to an exact-truth claim.

drills.title: Disappeared provider overlay blocks dependent actions without faking truth

flows.notes: A rapid invalidation burst coalesces in place; the strip stays visible but does not claim the burst already settled.
flows.recovery_summary: Shell strips coalesce the invalidation burst into one consistent frame and revalidate any pending exact-truth action against the producer before it commits.
flows.truth_posture_rationale: While coalescing the strip trails the live epoch, so it shows a freshness cue and revalidates instead of asserting the burst is already settled truth.

flows.notes: Backpressure overflow narrows the card to last-known truth and reloads from a fresh snapshot instead of replaying a lossy queue.
flows.recovery_summary: When the bounded delta queue overflows the card drops the lossy stream and requests a fresh consistent snapshot, narrowing to last-known read-only until it applies.
flows.truth_posture_rationale: Dropped frames break causality, so the card cannot prove current truth; it narrows to last-known and waits for the fresh snapshot rather than guessing.

flows.notes: CLI lag coalesces and stamps freshness so headless consumers can revalidate rather than trust a trailing line as current.
flows.recovery_summary: Headless output coalesces trailing deltas and stamps each emitted record with its epoch and a not-current freshness flag so scripts can revalidate before acting.
flows.truth_posture_rationale: Machine-readable output must never imply exact truth while trailing; the freshness flag and epoch stamp let a consumer decide instead of trusting a stale line.

flows.notes: A dropped subscription resubscribes from a fresh epoch and emits resubscribe-required rather than silently resuming the old stream.
flows.recovery_summary: After a dropped watcher the headless lane resubscribes from a new snapshot epoch and surfaces an explicit resubscribe-required state before exact-truth actions resume.
flows.truth_posture_rationale: A reconnect cannot silently resume the old epoch; the resubscribe-required state is emitted so the change in action posture is never hidden behind an automatic retry.

flows.notes: An invalidation gap marks the inspector epoch stale and narrows context instead of presenting a possibly-mismatched pin as current.
flows.recovery_summary: When the inspector detects a gap in the invalidation sequence it marks the epoch stale, narrows context to last-known, and requests a fresh snapshot before re-asserting any pin.
flows.truth_posture_rationale: A causality gap means the inspector cannot prove its context matches current truth; marking the epoch stale and narrowing keeps AI context honest rather than confidently wrong.

flows.notes: Review reconnect requires a visible resubscribe before approve or merge re-enable; no exact-truth action resumes silently.
flows.recovery_summary: A review workspace that lost its live link resubscribes to the merge-queue and pipeline streams and shows a resubscribe-required banner before approve or merge actions re-enable.
flows.truth_posture_rationale: Approve and merge depend on exact current state; the workspace requires a visible resubscribe before they re-enable so a reconnect never silently restores exact-truth actions.

flows.notes: A disappeared provider overlay blocks the dependent review actions and keeps the rows marked stale instead of pretending the overlay is still live.
flows.recovery_summary: When the remote preview or pipeline provider overlay disappears the workspace marks the overlaid rows stale and blocks exact-truth actions that depended on the missing provider.
flows.truth_posture_rationale: The provider that backed the overlay is gone, so those rows cannot claim current truth; blocking the dependent actions is honest while the workspace waits for the overlay to return.

flows.notes: A companion that loses its followed overlay narrows to last-known and reloads from a fresh snapshot rather than implying the session is still live.
flows.recovery_summary: When a followed provider overlay disappears the companion narrows its mirror to last-known and requests a fresh bounded snapshot rather than implying the followed session is still live.
flows.truth_posture_rationale: The companion mirror is read-bounded; if the overlay it followed is gone it shows last-known and waits for a fresh snapshot instead of asserting current followed state.

flows.notes: Companion lag coalesces into the bounded mirror with a freshness cue and revalidates scoped write-back instead of trusting a trailing frame.
flows.recovery_summary: A trailing companion snapshot coalesces deltas into its bounded mirror and revalidates any write-back inside scope before it commits while a freshness cue marks the lag.
flows.truth_posture_rationale: The companion may trail the live session; coalescing with a visible freshness cue keeps the mirror honest and revalidates scoped writes instead of trusting a trailing frame.

invariants: A consumer that is not on the current epoch never offers an action that depends on exact current truth.
Every recovery flow keeps a visible freshness cue and is support-exportable; recovery is never silent.
A materially changed action posture is never hidden behind an automatic silent retry.
Each lagging surface coalesces, resubscribes, requests fresh snapshots, or marks the epoch stale from one shared vocabulary instead of a private cache.
When a provider overlay disappears the dependent rows stay blocked or narrowed rather than reverting to an exact-truth claim.
title: Consumer-side reactive recovery flows for lagging subscription consumers
